tools.name: get_current_kp
tools.description: Current planetary Kp index: latest value, level (low/moderate/high/severe) and the observed 24-hour maximum.

tools.name: get_kp_forecast_3day
tools.description: Official NOAA 3-day geomagnetic forecast: the maximum expected Kp per calendar day (Europe/Berlin days).

tools.name: get_solar_flares_24h
tools.description: Solar X-ray activity of the past 24 hours from GOES: current flare class and the 24-hour peak class.

tools.name: get_aurora_visibility
tools.description: Aurora visibility outlook for a geographic latitude (degrees, e.g. 48.2 for Vienna): the Kp you need there, the expected maximum Kp in the next 24 h, and a verdict.
